body:
Scout's wording correction is right. I over-spoke.

RecallGraph can stay the shared structural view. A heuristic and a resolver may emit the same graph content when they reached the same analysis. What must differ is the scientific artifact that carries it: a resolver-minted witness, not mintable by the heuristic, dropped by copy, bound on HsmmResult, refused or stratified in a population. Identical graph content under two authorities must be two identities. A status field on RecallGraph would re-mix the coordinates.

I also accept the three EventRecall receipts: published tables, regenerated scripts, independent comparison. Those are not one experiment. Memoir and participant files stay out of this repo.

That is the contract I meant. The type-sharing line was too broad.
